# Get HLT configuration from parameters for semileptonic dataset
hlt_config = parameters.trigger_params["semileptonic"]

# Define skim cuts
skim_cuts = [

]

preselection_cuts = [

        "Njets_ge4",

            collection="JetGood",
            pt_cut=30,
            eta_cut=None,
            min=4,
        ),
    ),
    (
        "Nbjets_ge2",
        BtagMultiplicity(
            collection="JetGood",
            btagging_wp="deepflavour",
            min=2,
        ),
    ),
]

# Configuration dictionary for analysis
config = {
    "skim_cuts": skim_cuts,
    "preselection_cuts": preselection_cuts,
    "dataset": "semileptonic",
}
